title: Teraoka 2024 rear PPS block
citation: Teraoka, R., Kuroda, N., Kojima, R., & Teramoto, W. (2024). Comparison of peripersonal space in front and rear spaces. Experimental Brain Research, 242(4), 797–808.
notes: The rear timing preview includes the generated 500 ms start tone and 54 of the 56 published main trials. Both tone-only catches and the calibrated speaker-array procedure are required for a research launch.

reference_parameters.direction_assignment: One front block and one rear block for each participant. Trial order was randomized within blocks. Between-block order and counterbalancing are unreported.

participants.scope: Undergraduate and graduate students reporting normal hearing and touch.

apparatus.original_audio_output: Ten upward-facing Aura Sound NSW1-205-A loudspeakers along the head-centered sagittal axis at approximately chest height, driven with GNU Octave 6.2.0 and Playrec.

calibration.measured_at: Head center with the participant absent

apparatus.posture: Seated, head stationary and eyes closed during sound presentation. The tactor stays on the anterior chest in both directions.

auditory_timing.probe_signal: Pink noise crossfaded over four consecutive loudspeakers using overlapping cosine windows.

tactile_and_response.actuator: SHICOH C1034 vibration stimulator, 9.5 mm diameter
tactile_and_response.intensity: Well above detection threshold. Exact amplitude and threshold calibration are unreported.
tactile_and_response.task: Respond as quickly as possible to the tactile stimulus with the numeric keypad; withhold when touch is absent.

published_trial_schedule.timing_anchor_note: The baseline matches the probe trials. Adding the 500 ms tone duration to the baseline delays gives the same touch times as adding each target SOA to the 1500 ms probe onset. Physical event timestamps are unreported.

intertrial_interval_ms.selection: Random. The exact sampling distribution and realized intervals are unreported.

other_procedures.scope: Before the main assessment. Condition allocation is unreported.
12 per direction and path. Verbal estimates of the midpoint in meters without a tactile response.
Verbal speed magnitude relative to the middle/front reference assigned 10. Normal probes were 48 cm/s, with 32 and 96 cm/s fillers. Main speed analysis includes normal probes.
Several practice trials with the speed reference and verbal response.

reference_parameters.analysis: Trim log-transformed RTs once at ±3 SD per participant and condition. Collapse tactile timings. Compare probe RTs by direction and distance against the corresponding direction’s no-probe baseline.

inspection_scope.matched_baseline: The inspection builder retains the fixed 500 ms start tone and silences the pink probe. Baseline SOA values are stored relative to the nominal 1500 ms probe onset, including when the probe is silent.

inspection_only_cue_waveform.construction: For samples n=0…22049, both channels are 0.1 × sin(2π × 1000 × n / 44100). The digital level is selected for inspection and is not a measured study SPL.

inspection_scope.inspection_only_tactile_waveform: A 300 Hz, 100 ms digital sine marker uses a peak of 0.2 full scale. The original actuator drive shape and delivered mechanical amplitude are unreported.
inspection_scope.renderer: Each head-relative path is represented with a straight binaural pink-noise approach. Digital spatialization and level settings are inspection substitutes for the physical crossfading speaker array.
inspection_scope.timing_exclusions: The schedule omits the two tone-only catches, original randomized intertrial intervals, main-task familiarization and auxiliary tasks. It is not intended for study data collection.

implementation_gaps: The speaker array scheduler must present the start tone simultaneously on all ten calibrated channels and crossfade four speakers per approach. The stereo inspection sources do not implement that physical output.
The trial scheduler needs two distinct no-touch families: six probe catches and two tone-only catches per direction. The inspection scheduler only produces the six probe catches.
The bundled digital 1 kHz start tone is a synthesized timing cue. Original cue and probe files, speaker gains, calibrated sound levels and the Octave/Playrec routines are unavailable.
The study requires calibrated 300 Hz anterior chest vibration, synchronized keypad timing and the original event clock. The digital inspection does not verify physical vibration or response latency.

Exact intertrial interval sampling, between-direction order, keypad key and online response deadline are unreported. The original auditory estimation and familiarization schedules are outside the inspection.
